sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm in a shoe shop during my trip.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I need shoes for walking around the city.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, can I try them on in a size seven?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, we've got those walking shoes in stock today.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I sit here to put them on?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, take your time and walk around.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: They feel a bit loose when I take a step.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Let me see, does your heel move up when you walk?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Yes, my heel moves up inside the shoe.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Okay, try pulling the laces tighter first.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I adjust the laces and walk around the shop again.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: They're better, but my heel still moves a little.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No problem, we can try a smaller size for you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Have you got a size six in stock?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Let me check what we've got in the back.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I'm happy to try another color.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: We've got a six in blue, but the black ones only come in seven.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, which color have you got in a size six?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Blue in six, black in seven.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I choose the smaller pair and check how they feel.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I try them on in blue, please?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, here's the smaller pair to try.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: These feel better, and my heel doesn't move up now.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Good, can you move your toes without pushing the front?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Yes, they don't feel too tight around my feet.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Great, the price on the sign includes this blue pair.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: So they're forty pounds, just like the black ones?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Right, and there's no extra charge for the box.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'll take them and wear them out of the shop.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can you wrap up my old shoes for my bag?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, I'll wrap them in paper for you.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've found shoes that fit and checked the price.
